culture.en: The Roof of the World — Potala Palace, Jokhang Temple & Tibetan Buddhism. Sacred spiritual heart of Tibetan culture for 1,300 years.
culture.zh: 世界屋脊 — 布达拉宫、大昭寺与藏传佛教。1300 年藏族精神圣地。

climate.en: High-altitude semi-arid climate. Days 15-20°C, nights near 5°C even in summer. Strong UV.
climate.zh: 高海拔半干旱气候。白天15-20°C，夜间近5°C，夏季也凉；紫外线强。

transit.en: Taxis and buses; Lhasa Airport 60km away. Avoid rushing on arrival.
transit.zh: 出租车与公交；拉萨机场60公里。抵达勿剧烈活动。

intercity.en: Train from Xining (highest railway, scenic) or flight from Chengdu/Kunming.
intercity.zh: 西宁火车（世界最高铁路，风景绝美）或成都/昆明航班。

tips.en: Acclimatize 1-2 days, hydrate, avoid alcohol; permits needed for some border areas.
tips.zh: 先适应1-2天、多喝水、勿饮酒；部分边境需边防证。
